channel.title: RateLog — ChatGPT / Codex changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for ChatGPT / Codex, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: ChatGPT / Codex — Free-tier chat cap removed
item.description: [↑ improved] GPT-5.6 Luna became the default Free-tier model, and OpenAI began removing the numeric cap on Free-tier text chats entirely, moving toward "unlimited" (subject to abuse guardrails).

item.title: ChatGPT / Codex — Business seat price cut
item.description: [↑ improved] Cut ChatGPT Business per-seat price about $5: from $30/mo ($25 annual) down to $25/mo ($20 annual).

item.title: ChatGPT / Codex — Codex switched to token-based credits
item.description: [changed] Switched Codex from flat per-message billing to token-based credits at API rates for Plus, Pro, and Business — cost now scales with tokens used instead of one flat unit per task.
